candidate_relations.reason: The record shows benign irregular thin-walled vessels between collagen bundles without atypia and does not describe the retiform architecture or hobnail endothelial cells characteristic of retiform hemangioendothelioma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct low-grade vascular neoplasm, not microvenular hemangioma.

The absence of endothelial atypia and the very low proliferative index conflict with angiosarcoma, which requires malignant cytologic and architectural features.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct malignant endothelial neoplasm, not benign microvenular hemangioma.
